useCases.title: Work the review queue
mainFlow: 1. Officers work from a Booking Board that lists Submitted and Under Review requests ordered by ETA.
2. Booking Board can be filtered by terminal, status and ETA date range.

useCases.title: Open a request for review
postconditions: Request is locked for agent edits
mainFlow: 1. Opening a request for review moves it to Under Review and records the reviewing officer.

useCases.title: Record an approval decision
preconditions: For CargoClass = DangerousGoods: an inspection has been scheduled (see F005)
postconditions: ApprovalDecision recorded with Outcome, OfficerName, DecidedOn
Reason is required when Outcome = Rejected
BookingRequest.Status updated to Approved / Rejected accordingly
mainFlow: 1. Review screen shows the vessel's dimensions next to the berth's limits and highlights any exceedance in red.
2. Officer records one of three outcomes: Approved, Rejected or Returned for Information.
3. Rejection reason is required when outcome is Rejected.
4. There is no automatic approval; every booking request is reviewed by a berth officer before it can become Approved.

useCases.title: Return a request for information
postconditions: Request goes back to the agent
Agent may amend and resubmit once
mainFlow: 1. A request Returned for Information goes back to the agent, who may amend and resubmit it once.

useCases.title: Override a rejected decision
postconditions: New ApprovalDecision recorded with IsOverride = Yes and a reason
mainFlow: 1. Only the Harbour Master may override a Rejected decision, and the override is recorded with a reason.

useCases.title: Waive a berth-fit surcharge
postconditions: Surcharge waived on the booking's eventual invoice
mainFlow: 1. Only the Harbour Master may waive a tariff surcharge.

attributes.name: Reason
attributes.note: required when Outcome = Rejected — conditional, enforced in the microflow, not the domain model

microflows.name: ACT_BookingRequest_OpenForReview
microflows.purpose: Moves a Submitted booking to UnderReview and records the reviewing officer.

microflows.name: ACT_ApprovalDecision_Record
microflows.purpose: Records Approved/Rejected/ReturnedForInformation and updates the booking status.
validations: Reason is required when Outcome = Rejected.
DangerousGoods bookings require an inspection already scheduled before Outcome can be Approved (see F005 UC001).

microflows.name: ACT_ApprovalDecision_Override
microflows.purpose: Harbour-Master-only override of a Rejected decision.

pages.name: BookingBoard_Overview
pages.purpose: Submitted + UnderReview requests ordered by ETA, filterable by terminal/status/ETA range.

pages.name: OfficerReview_Screen
pages.purpose: Decision panel: vessel dims vs berth limits (exceedance highlighted red), Outcome, Reason.
